Our Story

Experts in SAP Financial Consolidation

Finsolves was founded with a singular mission: to help finance leaders harness the full power of SAP Group Reporting. We combine deep technical expertise with real-world financial knowledge to deliver solutions that truly transform how organizations close, consolidate, and report.

Headquartered in New York with a global delivery team, we've partnered with organizations across 40+ countries — from mid-market enterprises to Fortune 500 companies — to accelerate their financial close and improve reporting accuracy.
